summary: FingerMotion filed an 8-K covering a securities purchase agreement from an August 31, 2026 registered direct offering. The company sold 3,958,055 common shares at $0.24 per share plus pre-funded warrants for 12,708,611 shares at $0.2399 each, exercisable at $0.0001, to an institutional investor. Net proceeds were about $4.0 million for working capital. The warrants carry a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker, reducing immediate dilution. A prospectus supplement was filed under an existing S-3. No board recommendation or advisor was identified. Watch for dilution overhang and warrant exercise timing.
